name: Steamed Ragi Dhokla
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: 1 tsp fruit salt (Eno) or ½ tsp baking soda
Tempering: 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp mustard seeds, 6 curry leaves
steps: Whisk the ragi flour, besan, yogurt, paste, turmeric, salt and ½ cup water into a smooth, pourable batter. Rest for 10 minutes.
Grease a small plate or tin. Add the fruit salt to the batter, mix quickly, and pour into the tin.
Steam for 15 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool and cut into squares.
Heat the oil, crackle the mustard seeds, add curry leaves and 2 tbsp water, and pour over the dhokla.
note: Ragi adds calcium and fibre; steaming uses no oil in the cooking.
